title: Meals
text: Meals are reimbursable up to $60 per day for domestic travel and $90 per day for international travel. Alcohol is never reimbursable.

title: Lodging
text: Hotel lodging is reimbursable up to $180 per night domestic and $250 per night international.

title: Mileage
text: Use of a personal car for business is reimbursed at $0.67 per mile.

title: Airfare
text: Economy class only. Business class is allowed for flights longer than 6 hours, and only with manager approval.

title: Alcohol
text: Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances, including client dinners.

title: Receipts
text: A receipt is required for any single expense over $25. Expenses of $25 or less do not need a receipt.

title: Taxi and rideshare
text: Taxi and rideshare are reimbursable up to $50 per trip.

title: Submission deadline
text: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. Late claims are not eligible.

title: Home internet
text: Home internet for remote work is reimbursable up to $50 per month.
